purpose: Quantify sampling uncertainty for the frozen full transformation matrix and held-out FLUX evaluation without retraining, threshold changes, or model reselection.

method.stratification: Resample real and AI-generated indices independently with replacement, preserving 1000 examples per class.
method.pairing: Use the exact same bootstrap draws for every model and condition within each dataset.
method.multiple_comparison_adjustment: None; intervals are descriptive and not simultaneous family-wise guarantees.

interpretation.interval_scope: Uncertainty from resampling these fixed evaluation images only.
